_approach: The 'emotional peak' phrase of the breakdown (Myloops bars 17-24), where the lead/pad carries the weight and the drums step back entirely: no kick, no snare, just a conga call-and-response and a continuous shaker/tambourine bed keeping gentle motion under the melody without pulling focus from it. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
